purpose: Fail-closed integrity contract for candidate-managed Shine Defence review state across pre-certification staging and reviewed-release promotion.
managedAppRule: An app becomes candidate-managed once it has any record in review-candidates-v1. Before first certification it may remain pending-only outside the reviewed ledger; after acceptance it must have a coherent reviewed ledger, receipt and accepted decision.
preCertificationState: An app absent from the reviewed ledger must have no accepted candidate, accepted review decision or certification receipt.
Pending, dismissed and superseded candidate history may exist before first certification.
A pre-certification pending candidate never grants a badge.
requiredPromotionState: Exactly one accepted candidate for a reviewed candidate-managed app must match the app's current canonical reviewed-ledger identity.
That accepted candidate must have exactly one accepted review-decision record.
The app's current certification receipt must exactly match the accepted candidate and canonical reviewed-ledger identity.
A pending candidate may not already equal the app's current reviewed identity.
atomicity: First certification and later promotion both treat candidate state, canonical reviewed ledger, certification receipt and review decision as one CI-verified unit.
A partial certification or promotion is invalid even when each changed file is individually well-formed.
Repository merge atomicity is supplied by the reviewed pull-request commit; this contract verifies the resulting repository state, not a distributed transaction.
nonClaims: This contract does not make the review-decision ledger a badge authority.
Certification authority remains the canonical reviewed ledger plus exact certification receipt, subject to current revocation state.
Pre-certification candidate history is not certification.
